intro: Turn a product photo and a scene idea into a short clip for your store or ad. Set the format and explain the moment you want to show; the result stays centered on your product.

Use one upload to make a creator-style ad, product demo, unboxing or before-and-after clip, then choose a 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 or 3:4 frame and 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds. The workspace shows the credit cost before you start, so you can choose a version that fits the job.

faq.q: How do I make an AI video from a product photo?
faq.a: Upload one clear photo with the full item visible, choose a video type and frame, describe one action, then review the result. The credit cost appears before generation.

faq.q: What kinds of product videos can I create?
faq.a: Create creator-style product ads, product explainers, product showcases, avatar-based brand videos and social media clips from one product photo.

faq.q: Which video sizes and lengths are available?
faq.a: The workspace accepts 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3 and 3:4 frames, with 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds available for video jobs.
A 6-second clip uses 24 credits, 10 seconds uses 40, 15 seconds uses 60 and 30 seconds uses 120. The charge appears before you start, and credits return automatically if a job fails.

faq.q: Can I make several versions for A/B testing?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same product photo with a different opening, scene or actor, then compare the downloaded clips in your ad platform.
Use a clear, well-lit photo with the whole product in frame and the important details easy to see. Upload only a photo you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I use the downloaded clip in paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and usable for commercial work. Add your exact prices, captions and offers after download, then follow each platform's rules for AI content.

faq.q: Is the person in an AI video a real customer?
faq.a: No. Any presenter or creator-style person is generated for the ad, not a real customer review. Show the clip as a scripted product ad and disclose AI content when a platform requires it.

faq.q: How long does a video take to make?
faq.a: A finished clip is ready in minutes. The exact time varies with the length and server load, so you can start another version while you wait.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or creator?
faq.a: No. The people in the clips are generated around your product photo, so there is no casting, sample shipping or filming date. You can still work with a real creator later.
